Add-ons from features already in the catalog: a draft absence note the parent sends through the school's own channel (paste-ready wording, as G009 describes), tomorrow's calendar items that need a cancel or a cover (F009), a tracked ask to the other parent about staying home (the ask-and-relay step of G009), and a one-shot check-in reminder ('--at'). For 'can she go back tomorrow?' Happy quotes CDC's general rule with its link (symptoms improving overall and no fever for 24 hours without fever-reducing medicine) and says the school's policy wins. Rows delete themselves after 14 days and are kept out of memory writes. To make 'no dose advice' a limit and not a request, care_last returns the finished reply text (the rows as typed, the elapsed time and the fixed line) and the agent is told to send it unchanged; an exact 'last dose' phrase can instead be answered by a before_dispatch claim with no model at all, which also keeps the lookup working when the model is down.
